svg.title: CareNexus: a clearer kind of care
svg.desc: Animated header. Three real assessments play in turn: a mild headache graded self-care (tension headache), burning urination with fever graded see a doctor (urinary tract infection), and crushing chest pain graded emergency.

text.tspan: Describe what you feel. Learn how urgently to get
care, and what to do in the meantime.
